spans.s: When a firebrand is rotated, different circular figures are created. Some perceive these figures by rotating the firebrand as goblins or ghosts. But nobody has actually seen the goblin though much has been talked about them. This maxim is applicable to such false situations.
If a gourd is found inside a hard, thick rock, it will be as hard and thick as a rock. The company determines the qualities of a thing and shapes it accordingly.
